The '''''Daybreaker''''' was a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] converted into a [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transport]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dal (Cathar)|Dal]] and the ship's chief medical officer [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Senessa]], the ''Daybreaker'' traveled to the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]] around [[3643 BBY]] in order to deliver shipments of medical supplies, but arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] just as the Imperial warship [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']] attacked the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Uphrades]] with the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The ship's commander, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], dispatched boarding pods to destroy the medical frigate while the ''Oppressor'' departed the system, and the ''Daybreaker''{{'s}} [[Republic Military/Legends|military complement]] were unsuccessful in preventing the boarding.

However, a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] and crew arrived in the system not long after the ''Oppressor'' departed, and Captain Dal's emergency broadcast drew the Knight to the frigate. With the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] help, the crew were able to defeat the Imperial boarders, and Doctor Senessa assumed command of the ship when Captain Dal refused to aid the survivors on Uphrades' surface. The ''Daybreaker'' was intentionally stranded on Uphrades so that its crew could help those left on the surface to survive long enough for Republic aid.
